title: CWM: Controllable White-Box Meta-Prompting for Adaptive Retrieval-Augmented Generation and Reasoning Ability
abstract: arXiv:2609.15234v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have gained significant attention due to their strong language understanding and generation capabilities, demonstrating impressive reasoning abilities as well as effective utilization of external knowledge. Many studies have proposed methods that specialize in improving performance for individual tasks. However, ironically, only a limited number of attempts have explored general-purpose, task-agnostic methods. In this work, we present a unified framework integrating reasoning and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) tasks. We further propose Controllable White-Box Meta-Prompting (CWM), a low-cost white-box method for adaptive RAG tasks previously dominated by black-box approaches, without requiring external decision modules or multi-sampling. translated_title: CWM：用于自适应检索增强生成与推理能力的可控白盒元提示
translated_abstract: 近来，大型语言模型（LLMs）凭借其强大的语言理解与生成能力获得了广泛关注，不仅展现出令人印象深刻的推理能力，还能有效利用外部知识。许多研究提出了专门用于提升单个任务性能的方法。然而，具有讽刺意味的是，只有少量尝试探索了通用的、与任务无关的方法。在本工作中，我们提出了一个统一融合推理与检索增强生成（RAG）任务的框架。我们进一步提出了可控白盒元提示（CWM），这是一种低成本的（white-box）白盒方法，适用于此前一直被黑盒方法主导的自适应 RAG 任务，无需外部决策模块或多次采样。CWM 在三个自适应 RAG 基准测试中，在包括 GPT-oss-20b、Qwen3-14b 和 Llama3.1-8b 在内的近期大语言模型上取得了最先进的性能，同时还……
tldr: 提出了可控白盒元提示（CWM），一种无需外部决策模块或多次采样的低成本白盒方法，统一融合了推理与自适应检索增强生成任务，并在多个大语言模型的三个自适应 RAG 基准上取得了最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Controllable White-Box Meta-Prompting (CWM), a low-cost white-box method that unifies reasoning and adaptive RAG tasks without external decision modules or multi-sampling, achieving state-of-the-art performance on three adaptive RAG benchmarks across recent LLMs.
